# Catch up to nerd-fonts v3.5.1

243 glyphs are added, and no existing codepoint is moved or dropped (#138).

* Devicons v2.17.0 (105 icons added), Codicons 0.0.45 (102), Font Logos 1.4.0 (4), the Obsidian,
  Wireshark and zsh icons in Seti-UI + Custom (3), and `fa-volume` in Font Awesome (1)
* The progress indicators (`EE00`-`EE0B`, 12 glyphs) are added. They are scaled to be exactly one
  cell wide so that a progress bar can be tiled without a seam.
* Glyphs that are mapped to multiple codepoints are now copied to all of them. This keeps 5
  codicons that would have been lost with the new `codicon.ttf`, and recovers 16 Material Design
  codepoints that have been missing since v3.3.0.
* `0xE0CA`, `0xE0CC`-`0xE0D7` and `0x2630` (Powerline Extra) are now scaled as the other Powerline
  glyphs are. They used to keep the source size and stick out of the em box.

The glyph names of Codicons are now `uniEA60` and so on, as the upstream `codicon.ttf` no longer
carries readable names. Codepoints and shapes are not affected.
